steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic Android project files, including app-meta.json, build-steps.json, AndroidManifest.xml, and app/build.gradle with the specified environment and package name.

steps.title: Create Base Note Data Model
steps.description: Define a Java class 'Note' to represent individual notes, including properties for ID, title, content, and category. This will be used for data storage.

steps.title: Implement Data Storage Utility
steps.description: Create a 'NoteStorage' utility class to handle saving and loading notes and categories using SharedPreferences, serializing and deserializing them as JSON strings.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the layout for MainActivity, including a ListView to display notes, an EditText for search, a Spinner for category filtering, and a Button to add new notes.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Functionality
steps.description: Develop the MainActivity Java code to display notes, handle search and category filtering, manage note additions and deletions, and navigate to detail/category management activities.

steps.title: Create Note List Item Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for a single item in the notes ListView, showing the note title and a preview of its content.

steps.title: Create Note Detail Activity Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for NoteDetailActivity, providing EditText fields for note title and content, a Spinner for category selection, and buttons for saving and deleting a note.

steps.title: Implement Note Detail Activity Logic
steps.description: Develop the NoteDetailActivity Java code to allow users to create new notes or edit existing ones, including selecting a category and saving changes via the NoteStorage utility.

steps.title: Design Category Management Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the layout for CategoryManageActivity, featuring an EditText and Button to add new categories, and a ListView to display and allow deletion of existing categories.

steps.title: Create Category List Item Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for a single item in the category ListView, simply displaying the category name.

steps.title: Implement Category Management Activity Logic
steps.description: Develop the CategoryManageActivity Java code to allow users to add new categories and delete existing ones, updating the categories stored in SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Building Notes Categorized
steps.description: Compile and assemble the 'Notes Categorized' application into a debug APK.
